en: [[Duke]] [[asked]] [[Morris]] [[when the meeting would end]], as he needed to go to the restroom, a question he had been avoiding asking all morning.
key: Duke는 Morris에게 질문을 했다(회의가 언제 끝나는지).
me: as he needed to go to the restroom,
a question he had been avoiding asking all morning.
easy: Duke asked Morris when the meeting would end
Duke는 Morris에게 회의가 언제 끝날지 물었다.
as he needed to go to the restroom
a question he had been avoiding asking all morning
그가 아침 내내 묻기를 피해 온 질문.
요약: Duke는 화장실이 급해서 미뤄 둔 질문을 했다.
notes: avoid(피하다)는 동명사(-ing)만 목적어로 취한다: avoid asking(묻기를 피하다) ○, avoid to ask ✕
a question he had been avoiding ~ = 그가 피해 온 질문 (앞 명사를 꾸미는 말, 관계대명사 생략)

en: Considering the world market, [[we]] [[can only guess]] [[that our business will suffer for a while]], while the situation continues to worsen across the region.
me: that our business will suffer for a while,
while the situation continues to worsen across the region.
easy: that our business will suffer for a while
우리 사업이 한동안 어려움을 겪을 것이라고.
while the situation continues to worsen across the region
그 지역 전역에서 상황이 계속 나빠지는 동안.
요약: 상황이 계속 나빠지는 동안 우리 사업도 힘들 것이다.
notes: while + 주어+동사(절) = ~하는 동안, during + 명사(구) = ~ 동안. 뒤에 절이 있으면 while
continue(계속하다) to + 동사원형 = 계속 ~하다 (continues to worsen = 계속 나빠진다, worsen(악화되다))

en: [[I]] [[was]] [[curious]] about who made Maya change her mind at the last moment, a decision that left her feeling relieved afterward.
me: about who made Maya change her mind at the last moment,
a decision that left her feeling relieved afterward.
easy: about who made Maya change her mind at the last moment
누가 마지막 순간에 Maya의 마음을 바꾸게 했는지.
a decision that left her feeling relieved afterward
요약: Maya가 마음을 바꾼 이유가 궁금했고, 그 결정은 결국 안도감을 주었다.
notes: 감정을 느끼는 사람 → 과거분사(-ed): 그녀가 안도를 느끼니까 relieved(안도한), relieving(안도시키는) ✕
make(만들다) + 목적어 + 동사원형 = ~가 …하게 하다 (made Maya change = Maya가 바꾸게 했다)

en: [[She]] [[wanted to know]] [[if her grandmother had ever actually seen an angel]], as if she were standing right there in the room with her.
me: if her grandmother had ever actually seen an angel,
as if she were standing right there in the room with her.
easy: if her grandmother had ever actually seen an angel
할머니가 실제로 천사를 본 적이 있는지.
as if she were standing right there in the room with her
마치 할머니가 바로 그 방에 그녀와 함께 서 있는 것처럼.
요약: 할머니가 천사를 정말 본 적 있는지, 그것도 바로 곁에서 본 듯이 궁금해했다.
notes: as if + 가정법 과거 = 마치 ~인 것처럼 (사실과 반대). be동사는 주어와 상관없이 were
as if 뒤에 she가 나와도 was가 아니라 were: as if she were standing(서 있는 것처럼, stand(서다))

en: [[Mr. Williams]] [[was]] [[unaware]] of whether his family was planning for his birthday, though the plans, which relied on everyone's schedule, were arranged carefully in advance.
me: of whether his family was planning for his birthday,
though the plans, which relied on everyone's schedule, were arranged carefully in advance.
easy: of whether his family was planning for his birthday
though the plans were arranged carefully in advance
비록 그 계획들은 미리 신중하게 준비되었지만.
요약: 가족은 생일 계획을 몰래 꼼꼼히 준비해 두었다.
notes: 주어와 동사 사이에 꾸미는 말이 끼어 있어도 동사는 진짜 주어에 맞춘다: the plans(복수) → was ✕ were ○

en: [[One of the most essential decisions we can make]] [[is]] [[how we should invest our time every day]], and never do we truly appreciate this until it is too late.
me: One of the most essential decisions we can make
how we should invest our time every day,
and never do we truly appreciate this until it is too late.
easy: One of the decisions is how we should invest our time
결정 중 하나는 시간을 어떻게 투자해야 하는지이다.
the most essential decisions we can make
우리가 내릴 수 있는 가장 중요한 결정들.
how we should invest our time every day
매일 우리 시간을 어떻게 써야 하는지.
never do we truly appreciate this until it is too late
너무 늦을 때까지 우리는 이것의 가치를 결코 진정으로 알지 못한다.
요약: 시간을 어떻게 쓸지가 중요한데, 사람들은 늦어서야 깨닫는다.
notes: never, hardly, little 같은 부정 부사가 문장 맨 앞에 오면 (조)동사 + 주어 순서로 뒤집는다: Never do we ~ (우리는 결코 ~않는다)
One of the + 복수명사가 주어일 때 진짜 주어는 One → 단수동사 is

en: [[I]] really [[wonder]] [[where they found such a wonderful sofa for their living room]], though nobody could explain why it cost so much to import.
me: where they found such a wonderful sofa for their living room,
though nobody could explain why it cost so much to import.
easy: where they found such a wonderful sofa for their living room
그들이 거실에 놓을 그렇게 멋진 소파를 어디서 찾았는지.
though nobody could explain why it cost so much to import
비록 그것이 수입하는 데 왜 그렇게 많은 비용이 들었는지는 아무도 설명하지 못했지만.
요약: 멋진 소파를 어디서 구했는지 궁금한데, 왜 비싼지는 아무도 모른다.
notes: why / where / how 뒤에는 완전한 절, what 뒤에는 불완전한 절. it cost so much to import는 주어(it)와 동사(cost)가 다 있는 완전한 절 → why
why it cost so much = 왜 그렇게 많은 비용이 들었는지 (cost(비용이 들다))

en: Close [[your eyes]] and imagine that you are standing on top of a mountain, feeling the wind and hearing what echoes through the valley below.
me: and imagine that you are standing on top of a mountain,
feeling the wind and hearing what echoes through the valley below.
easy: imagine that you are standing on top of a mountain
네가 산꼭대기에 서 있다고 상상해 봐라.
feeling the wind and hearing what echoes through the valley below
바람을 느끼고 저 아래 계곡에 울려 퍼지는 것을 들으면서.
요약: 눈을 감고 산꼭대기에서 바람과 메아리를 느껴 보라.
notes: what = ~하는 것. echoes(울려 퍼지다)의 주어가 없는 불완전한 절 앞이므로 that ✕ what ○ (hearing what echoes = 울려 퍼지는 것을 듣는)
명령문은 주어 You 없이 동사원형으로 시작한다 (Close = 감아라, close(감다))
